digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and Git repository fetch optimization
propositions: CI tickets-branch fetches must apply blob:none filter across all checkout paths to reduce transfer cost from 1.04 GiB / 59s to 68.7 MiB / 14.3s for standalone and from 6.73 minutes to 3.6-8.6s for Gerrit verify-identity

Standalone verify-identity must enforce REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=102400 by parsing git count-objects -v immediately after actions/checkout and rejecting unfiltered full-history packs exceeding the limit
Gerrit verify-identity must enforce REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=131072 after filtered fetch and worktree materialization, and verify no promisor objects are added during identity scanning
Git protocol must advertise filter capability and send filter blob:none for both named-origin inheritance and direct-URL fetches, leaving historical blobs missing before materialization
All target workflows must retain fetch-depth: 0 and existing credential/ref settings while adding filter: blob:none to actions/checkout and --filter=blob:none to explicit git fetch commands
Blobless tickets must reconverge independent local/remote changes with the ours driver, retain expected events, and push successfully without adding promisor objects
